subject.title: fix(ui): show run failures above composer

question: Should Gateway clients be expected to handle a source-reply final followed by a terminal error for the same run, with the Control UI presenting the error outside the transcript?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes terminal event ordering across the Gateway/UI boundary; tests demonstrate the new behavior but do not establish that all existing Gateway consumers share this lifecycle contract.

options.title: Confirm and document final-then-error
options.body: Accept the new lifecycle, verify affected Gateway consumers tolerate it, and retain the focused regression coverage.

options.title: Keep final terminal for source replies
options.body: Preserve the prior single-final Gateway behavior and move the UI alert to an explicitly additive error signal if the existing client contract requires one terminal outcome.

recommendation.title: Confirm and document final-then-error
recommendation.body: Accept the new lifecycle, verify affected Gateway consumers tolerate it, and retain the focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current implementation and linked reproduction, making them the best available routing contact for the intended behavior; broader Gateway ownership was not established from supplied history.
